title_en: Florida AG announces investigation into OpenAI over shooting that allegedly involved ChatGPT
title_he: Florida AG announces investigation into OpenAI over shooting that allegedly involved ChatGPT
description_en: ChatGPT had reportedly been used to plan the attack that killed two and injured five at Florida State University last April. The family of one victim has said that they plan to sue OpenAI over the incident.
